sentence: The committee decided to ___ the working conditions.
explanation: La palabra "ameliorate" significa mejorar algo o hacerlo más tolerable.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'mejorar' — starts with 'amel-'

sentence: The report provides a ___ analysis of the data.
explanation: La palabra "comprehensive" significa que incluye o abarca todos o casi todos los elementos o aspectos de algo; es decir, exhaustivo o completo.
tip: Adjective meaning 'exhaustivo, completo' — starts with 'compre-'

sentence: The new policy will ___ to address the issue of inequality.
explanation: La palabra "endeavor" significa esforzarse mucho por hacer o lograr algo.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'esforzarse' — starts with 'ende-'

sentence: The evidence presented was ___.
explanation: La palabra "unequivocal" significa que no deja lugar a dudas; inequívoco.
tip: Adjective meaning 'inequívoco' — un + equivocal

sentence: The government's actions could ___ the economic crisis.
explanation: La palabra "exacerbate" significa empeorar un problema, una mala situación o un sentimiento negativo.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'empeorar/agravar' — starts with 'exacer-'

sentence: The study aims to ___ the complex relationship between the two variables.
explanation: La palabra "elucidate" significa aclarar algo; explicar.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'aclarar/explicar' — starts with 'eluci-'

sentence: The committee reached a ___ on the proposed changes.
explanation: Un "consensus" es un acuerdo general.
tip: Noun meaning 'acuerdo general' — starts with 'consen-'

sentence: The new technology will ___ communication between departments.
explanation: La palabra "facilitate" significa hacer que una acción o proceso sea fácil o más fácil.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'facilitar' — same root as Spanish!

sentence: The research findings were ___ by empirical data.
explanation: La palabra "substantiate" significa aportar pruebas para respaldar o demostrar la veracidad de algo.
tip: Past participle meaning 'respaldado con pruebas' — from 'substantiate'

sentence: The speaker's arguments were ___ and well-reasoned.
explanation: La palabra "cogent" describe un argumento o caso que es claro, lógico y convincente.
tip: Adjective meaning 'convincente, lógico' — 6 letters, starts with 'cog-'

sentence: The company aims to ___ the risks associated with the investment.
explanation: La palabra "mitigate" significa hacer que algo sea menos severo, grave o doloroso.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'mitigar' — same root as Spanish!

sentence: The report highlighted the ___ influence of social media.
explanation: La palabra "pervasive" significa que se extiende ampliamente por una zona o un grupo de personas (especialmente una influencia o efecto físico no deseado).
tip: Adjective meaning 'omnipresente, extendido' — starts with 'perva-'

sentence: The committee decided to ___ the new regulations.
explanation: La palabra "promulgate" significa promover o dar a conocer ampliamente una idea o causa.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'promulgar' — same root as Spanish!

sentence: The artist's work is characterized by its ___ beauty.
explanation: La palabra "ephemeral" significa que dura muy poco tiempo.
tip: Adjective meaning 'efímero' — same root as Spanish!

sentence: The new evidence will ___ the witness's testimony.
explanation: La palabra "corroborate" significa confirmar o respaldar una afirmación, teoría o hallazgo.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'corroborar' — same root as Spanish!

sentence: The government's policy was met with ___.
explanation: La palabra "opprobrium" significa crítica dura o censura pública.
tip: Two words: 'widespread' + formal noun for 'censura pública' (starts with 'oppro-')

sentence: The scientist's theory was based on ___ rather than fact.
explanation: Una "conjecture" es una opinión o conclusión formada a partir de información incompleta; es decir, una conjetura o suposición.
tip: Noun meaning 'conjetura' — same root as Spanish!

sentence: The company decided to ___ its new strategy.
explanation: La palabra "delineate" significa describir o representar algo con precisión.
tip: Formal verb meaning 'delinear/describir con precisión' — same root as Spanish!

sentence: The new law will have ___.
explanation: "Far-reaching implications" se refiere a efectos o consecuencias importantes y de gran alcance.
tip: Two words: adjective meaning 'de gran alcance' + noun meaning 'implicaciones'

sentence: The committee's decision was met with ___.
explanation: "Unanimous approval" significa que dos o más personas están totalmente de acuerdo; aprobación unánime.
tip: Two words: 'unánime' + 'aprobación' — both cognates!
